content: Another advantage of using the INLINEFORM0 lies in the fact that it directly connects INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 . This direct connection helps and stabilizes training, since the terminal error signals can be easily backpropagated to model parameters. Fig. FIGREF23 illustrates paths between the two cell states.
